name: MonarchCallStage
title: CallStage
wrapsNative: A SwiftUI VStack with LazyVGrid (grid) or HStack/VStack plus a horizontal ScrollView filmstrip (spotlight) of MonarchCallTile, Text(_:style: .timer) for the call duration, MonarchCalloutBanner and MonarchInlineNotice for notices, a controls slot for MonarchCallControls, and AccessibilityNotification.Announcement
summary: The call itself: a header with the title, a running timer and the head count, everyone's call tiles in a grid or a spotlight with a filmstrip, connection notices and the controls.
whenToUse: For an active audio or video call, full screen or docked in a corner, and as the content of a picture in picture window (surface .pip).
whenNotToUse: Before joining, show a pre-join lobby screen. For one participant's view alone use MonarchCallTile. The minimized call is system picture in picture (mini-call), not a smaller stage.
api: init(_ title: String? = nil, participants: [MonarchCallStageParticipant], startedAt: Date? = nil, mode: MonarchCallControlsLayout = .automatic, pinnedID: Binding<String?>? = nil, activeSpeakerID: String? = nil, layout: MonarchCallStageLayout? = nil, surface: MonarchCallStageSurface = .stage, isLowData: Bool = false, isReconnecting: Bool = false, error: String? = nil, isSpeakingWhileMuted: Bool = false, labels: MonarchCallStageLabels = MonarchCallStageLabels(), onSurfaceChange: (@MainActor (MonarchCallStageSurface) -> Void)? = nil, onMinimize: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onPictureInPicture: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onFullScreen: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder video: @escaping (MonarchCallStageParticipant) -> Video, @ViewBuilder controls: () -> Controls)

options.name: title
options.description: The heading, such as the meeting name; also names the stage. "Call" is spoken without it.

options.name: participants
options.description: Everyone on the call, you included (isSelf), in display order, with what each tile shows.

options.name: startedAt
options.description: When the call started: shows the system's running timer text.

options.name: mode
options.description: The layout chosen in MonarchCallControls: automatic, grid or speaker.

options.name: pinnedID
options.description: The pinned participant, shown large. Adds Pin buttons to the tiles on the full stage.

options.name: activeSpeakerID
options.description: Who is talking, for speaker mode.

options.name: surface
options.description: stage, docked or pip. Compact surfaces have at most two columns and no tile buttons.

options.name: isLowData
options.description: Shows the "Low data" badge in the header.

options.name: isReconnecting
options.description: Shows the warning "You're offline. Trying to reconnect…".

options.name: error
options.description: A problem in the product's words, shown as a danger callout and announced.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string, including the tiles'.

options.name: onSurfaceChange
options.description: Adds Shrink (sends .docked) on the stage and Expand (sends .stage) when docked.

options.name: onPictureInPicture
options.description: Adds the picture in picture button, except on the pip surface.

options.name: onFullScreen
options.description: Adds full screen to each tile on the full stage; receives the participant id.

options.name: video
options.description: The participant's video view from the product's call SDK, such as a UIViewRepresentable around its renderer.

options.name: controls
options.description: The controls row under the tiles, usually MonarchCallControls.

states.name: grid
states.description: Tiles in equal columns: one, two up to four people, then three; at most two on a narrow screen or a compact surface.

states.name: spotlight
states.description: A pin, someone else's shared screen, the speaker in speaker mode or the other person in a one-to-one call is large; the others are in a filmstrip below that scrolls sideways, or in a column beside it on a wide full stage.

states.name: waiting
states.description: Alone on the call, the header reads "Waiting for others…" instead of the head count.

states.name: reconnecting
states.description: A warning callout with an offline symbol under the header, announced when it appears.

states.name: error
states.description: A danger callout with the product's message, announced when it appears or changes.

states.name: muted while speaking
states.description: A warning notice under the tiles, announced when it appears.

states.name: docked and pip
states.description: Smaller padding, at most two columns and no Pin or full screen buttons; docked shows Expand and Minimize.

appearance: The stage sits on the subtle background with a large rounded corner; the title is the default text colour and the timer and head count the muted text colour. Tiles, notices, the badge and the controls are the Monarch components with their own theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes are covered.
platformNotes: The web's region becomes a SwiftUI accessibility container. The video is a view slot per participant instead of a MediaStream and onVideoElement; system picture in picture is opened by the product (see mini-call), so onPictureInPicture only reports the button. The web's 'mini' surface change is onMinimize. The timer is the system's Text timer style rather than a ticking component, so it needs no clock and is never announced every second. The web's muted hint mentions keyboard shortcuts; iOS says to turn the microphone on. The stage grows with its tiles instead of filling a container: give it a frame to fill a screen. The grid's narrow-screen cap follows the horizontal size class rather than a 30rem width. Android ships the same MonarchCallStage.
accessibility: The stage is an accessibility container labelled with the title, or "Call".
The title has the header trait.
The timer is labelled "Call duration" with the updates-frequently trait; VoiceOver reads the time when focused and does not announce each second.
Changes are announced once with AccessibilityNotification.Announcement, in this order of priority: a new error, losing the connection, the muted hint, a new head count.
Header buttons are plain buttons with an SF Symbol, an accessibility label and a 44-point target.
Each tile is MonarchCallTile: one element per person named by their name with speaking, muted, hand raised, screen, status and quality as its value.
edgeCases: A pinned or spotlighted id that is not among the participants is ignored and the grid is shown.
Your own shared screen never takes the spotlight; the speaker is never yourself.
Ids in a given layout without a participant draw nothing.
Many participants make the stage tall; it does not scroll itself, so put it in a ScrollView or give it a frame.
Long titles and names wrap; at the largest text sizes tiles grow taller than 16 by 9.
Announcements and the timer were not checked with VoiceOver on a device; the layout choice, columns, buttons, head count and announcements are unit-tested.

examples.template:
MonarchCallStage(
    {{title}},
    participants: [
        MonarchCallStageParticipant({{participants.0.id}}, name: {{participants.0.name}}, isSelf: {{participants.0.self}}, isMicOff: !isMicOn),
        MonarchCallStageParticipant({{participants.1.id}}, name: {{participants.1.name}}, isSpeaking: {{participants.1.speaking}}, quality: {{participants.1.quality|case}}),
        MonarchCallStageParticipant({{participants.2.id}}, name: {{participants.2.name}}, isMicOff: {{participants.2.micOff}}, quality: {{participants.2.quality|case}}),
        MonarchCallStageParticipant({{participants.3.id}}, name: {{participants.3.name}}, isHandRaised: {{participants.3.handRaised}}, quality: {{participants.3.quality|case}}),
    ],
    startedAt: startedAt,
    mode: mode,
    activeSpeakerID: {{activeSpeakerId}},
    surface: surface,
    onSurfaceChange: { surface = $0 },
    controls: {
        MonarchCallControls(isMicOn: $isMicOn, layout: $mode, isMinimal: surface != .stage, onLeave: {})
    }
)
examples.code:
MonarchCallStage(
    "Weekly planning",
    participants: [
        MonarchCallStageParticipant("me", name: "Sam Lee", isSelf: true, isMicOff: !isMicOn),
        MonarchCallStageParticipant("robin", name: "Robin Park", isSpeaking: true, quality: .good),
        MonarchCallStageParticipant("alex", name: "Alex Chen", isMicOff: true, quality: .fair),
        MonarchCallStageParticipant("jordan", name: "Jordan Diaz", isHandRaised: true, quality: .good),
    ],
    startedAt: startedAt,
    mode: mode,
    activeSpeakerID: "robin",
    surface: surface,
    onSurfaceChange: { surface = $0 },
    controls: {
        MonarchCallControls(isMicOn: $isMicOn, layout: $mode, isMinimal: surface != .stage, onLeave: {})
    }
)
